title: HCDIR: End-to-end Hate Context Detection, and Intensity Reduction model for online comments
benchmark_measurement: Detection of religious hate speech as one of several categories within a broader hate speech detection task.
findings: The paper does not offer findings specific to religious hate speech. It evaluates models on datasets for various Indian languages, one of which (BD-SHS for Bengali) explicitly includes 'religious hate' as a sub-category. The models achieve high overall performance (e.g., 0.92 Macro F1 score on the BD-SHS dataset) for general hate speech detection, but the results are not disaggregated by hate speech type.
